page.overview:
Who is Owen Grady?

Owen Grady is an animal behaviorist who was employed by Jurassic World as a Velociraptor trainer. After the fall of Jurassic World in 2015, Grady enters an on-and-off relationship with Claire Dearing, the former business operations manager of Jurassic World. Claire would later recruit him to help save Blue, a raptor he raised, from the eruption of Mt. Sibo. Owen would later participate in an incident at Lockwood Manor in which he witnessed dinosaurs being released into the wider world.

Owen is still in a relationship with Claire and, alongside her, is also a guardian and the adoptive father of Maisie Lockwood. He works in collaboration with the Department of Fish and Wildlife.

Owen Grady is portrayed in the Jurassic World trilogy by American actor Chris Pratt and in expanded media by various actors. He is the deuteragonist of the Jurassic World trilogy, being the deuteragonist of Jurassic World and Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom, and one of the six main protagonists (alongside Claire Dearing, Alan Grant, Kayla Watts, Ian Malcolm, and Ellie Sattler) of Jurassic World: Dominion.

Little is known of Owen's life before being a member of the U.S. Navy and his later employment at Jurassic World is known. His background has never been mentioned in detail. At some point either before, during, or after joining the United States Navy, Owen met Barry who was also an animal behaviorist.

Also known as: Owen.
